Meet Dease's Auto and Cycle

One shop for auto and cycle

Dease's Auto and Cycle

Dease's Auto and Cycle is a repair shop in Pottstown, PA, working on cars and motorcycles. Its own gallery is full of custom motorcycles, plus the red flatbed rollback tow truck the shop runs.

Open Monday to Saturday, 9 AM to 5 PM. Call the shop to talk through the work your car or bike needs.

Open Mon – Sat

Monday to Saturday 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM. Closed Sunday.

On S Adams St

51 S Adams St, Pottstown, PA 19464. A local repair shop with a focus on custom motorcycles.
